question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        im.month_year,
        im.interest_id,
        im.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC) AS rn
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.composition IS NOT NULL
),
per_interest_max AS (
    SELECT r.month_year, r.interest_id, r.composition
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, composition
    FROM per_interest_max
    ORDER BY composition DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
bottom10 AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, composition
    FROM per_interest_max
    ORDER BY composition ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
    t.month_year AS time,
    m.interest_name,
    t.composition
FROM top10 t
JOIN interest_map m ON m.id = t.interest_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    b.month_year AS time,
    m.interest_name,
    b.composition
FROM bottom10 b
JOIN interest_map m ON m.id = b.interest_id
